text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is finally the debut race. It's 
nothing like a mock race at the academy, 
so normally one would be nervous, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr is completely her usual 
self. It seems she hardly pays any mind to 
the spectators or the other runners to 
begin with.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking of nothing but becoming the wind 
upon the turf, she headed into the race.
